ops.title: System operations
ops.subtitle: Purge operational data, backup/restore the database, inspect health, and restart services. Assets, beacons, gateways, and users are never in the purge list.

ops.healthHint: The MQTT worker must be up to ingest reports. Restarting PostgreSQL / Redis / MQTT briefly interrupts traffic.
ops.restartConfirm: This will restart “{name}”. Type RESTART to confirm.
ops.cleanupHint: Only expired operational rows. Assets, beacons, gateways, maps, users, and rules are not deleted. New installs enable daily automatic purge.
ops.previewEmpty: Nothing older than the retention window
ops.cleanupConfirm: This deletes {total} matching rows. This cannot be undone.
ops.cleanupConfirmBackground: Expired operational rows will be deleted in the background. Assets, beacons, gateways, and users are not deleted. This cannot be undone.
ops.cleanupStarted: Cleanup started in the background. Watch progress on this page.
ops.autoCleanupHint: By default the job runs daily around 03:20 (failed MQTT frames ~3 days, scans ~2 days). Successful MQTT frames are not stored. You can change days or turn it off. Container logs rotate and will not grow without bound.
ops.autoCleanupNeedRules: Select at least one rule before enabling automatic purge
ops.backupHint: Creates a gzip-compressed PostgreSQL dump (.sql.gz). Raw MQTT inbox payloads are omitted. Successful frames are no longer stored; use cleanup above to drop leftover inbox rows and expired scans.
ops.toolsMissing: pg_dump / psql are missing, so backup and restore are unavailable.
ops.restoreHint: Restore takes a safety dump first, then overwrites all business data and restarts the API. You must type RESTORE.
ops.restoreConfirm: This overwrites the database with “{name}”. Type RESTORE to confirm. You will need to sign in again after the restart.
ops.restoreAccepted: Restore submitted. The API is restarting — refresh and sign in again shortly.
ops.dockerOff: Docker is not mounted, so Postgres / Redis / MQTT / Web cannot be restarted here. API and Worker still can.

rules.title: Alert rules
rules.subtitle: Configure triggers and thresholds for beacon/gateway/asset offline, low battery, weak signal, and inventory results. Hits create alert events and can notify via My notifications.

BEACON_OFFLINE.label: Beacon offline
BEACON_OFFLINE.hint: Alert when not scanned by any gateway beyond this many seconds

GATEWAY_OFFLINE.label: Gateway offline
GATEWAY_OFFLINE.hint: Alert when no heartbeat/report beyond this many seconds

ASSET_OFFLINE.label: Asset offline
ASSET_OFFLINE.hint: Bound asset: alert when beacon not scanned beyond this many seconds

BATTERY_LOW.label: Low battery
BATTERY_LOW.hint: Alert when battery % ≤ threshold (estimate from level if no %)

INVENTORY_RESULT.label: Inventory result
INVENTORY_RESULT.hint: Push result after inventory. Coverage below threshold → WARNING, else INFO (subscribe in My notifications)

RSSI_THRESHOLD.label: Weak signal (RSSI)
RSSI_THRESHOLD.hint: Alert when smoothed online RSSI is weaker (more negative), e.g. -85
